method.standard: cargo xtask package invokes release --no-default-features; voice included. Sum all 206 regular files. Complete portable ZIP with ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc, without an enclosing directory. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized. All 12 runtime workspace crates freshly rebuilt from the after worktree following reviewed name-scoped release invalidation across worktree PackageIDs; optimized demo immediately follows the unchanged same worktree.
method.native: Both release default+demo executables use unchanged FAT LTO and codegen-units=1. Identical --demo --demo-call workload, 1120×760 logical viewport at 2× scale. 5-second warmup plus ten one-second macOS ps readings. Settled RSS is the median of the last five. Team-confirmed global quiet with all compilers, tests, other native apps and helper child processes stopped.
method.replay: Both binaries use unchanged repository release defaults. One warmup and five alternating pairs, each 100,000 synthetic reducer events. All five after reducer workspace crates freshly compiled. Both native apps stopped before replay. Retained timeline is an estimate, not process RSS.

limitations: Offline demo and reducer workloads use no account, network writes or media devices. They do not reproduce recipient HTTP behavior.
Tiny timing/RSS differences and quantized idle CPU are not improvement claims.
Live ringing permissions/delivery/latency, UI frame/startup latency and GPU memory remain unverified.
Existing before/after UI images use a disclosed synthetic native fixture and an earlier source with identical English recipient layout; they do not prove live interoperability.

resource_bounds.metadata_note: The ID-buffer figure excludes fixed 64-entry Option<RecipientCall> Vec storage, active record headers and Arc/Mutex metadata. Each of 65 records owns two bounded 64-ID vectors.
